connector.name: Judgment Pack
connector.registryDescription: Offline JPS validator, conformance tester, and experimental evaluator over stdio MCP; keyless.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image judgment-pack:0.11.0. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the judgment-pack account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: JPACK_CONFIG
env.description: Path to a jpack.json project configuration (ADR-0012). Optional: without it the server reads jpack.json from its launch directory (/project in this image; mount a project there), and a project that does not use the convention still validates and evaluates pack documents passed over the wire.
